contributions.statement: Add an agent triage step on SCA dependency-CVE alerts that reads the repository and proposes affected/not-affected, but keep its justification as a proposal for human or reachability-tool confirmation, since only one model exceeded 70% macro-F1 on the reason.
contributions.evidence: Table 2: status F1 81.6 +/- 3.8 (Opus 4.6, Claude Code), 79.9 +/- 8.0 (GPT-5.5, Codex) over 3 runs; justification macro-F1 73.5 best, next 64.6. Table 3: OSV-Scanner F1 40.5, Trivy 36.1 (precision ~26-27%), though the case selection nearly guarantees SCA low precision. 25 of 75 cases are Java/Maven-Gradle; 29% affected base rate.

reason: Multi-run, leakage-checked evidence with Java cases that agent triage of SCA alerts is useful for status but unreliable for justification; the SCA-baseline gap is partly by construction.
